description: This PHP class 'EmployeeEventService' provides methods for managing employee events within the OrangeHRM system, including saving, updating, and retrieving employee event records, and handling user roles.

classes.name: EmployeeEventService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee event operations such as saving, updating, and retrieving employee events, with role management and timestamp functionalities.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeEventDao instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeEvent object to the database.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves a new EmployeeEvent with specified parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves employee events based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the role of the current user or 'System' if no user is logged in.

methods.name: saveAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an event indicating an employee was added.

methods.name: saveUpdateEmployeePersonalDetailsEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an event indicating employee personal details were updated.

methods.name: saveUpdateJobDetailsEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an event indicating employee job details were updated.
